sources.title: Jupyter nbformat v4.5 JSON schema
sources.pin: schema sha256:523e3578ddbfcad52933d2423dc5951114ef73f48df180b6a601498ba5ca071a; supplied listing reports shared git blob 670bbd35f343f0d1324b8e6056ba42420f7ec6aa for v4 and v4.5 schemas
sources.locator: Cell array; cell IDs; code-cell execution_count integer or null (null means not run); saved outputs; kernelspec metadata. Schema specifies document shape, not a complete kernel event history or replay semantics.
sources.applicability: Interchange/document facts; limits on historical execution recovery are an inference from the schema's per-cell fields.

sources.title: marimo README

sources.applicability: Static impact analysis mechanism and its mutation limitation.
